meta.name: Yodelin' Kid from Pine Ridge
meta.description:
Parker (LeRoy Mason) steals cattle from the cattlemen and blames it on the turpentiners. 
Then he incites the cattlemen to burn down the turpentiners trees. 
When Gene finds the rustled cattle he tries to kill him. 
Failing, he kills both Gene's father (Charles Middleton) and Bayliss Baynum (Russell Simpson) and has Gene arrested for Baynum's murder.
